Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. That looks right to me. A few clarifications from procurement/security: 
- We do require an executed BAA before ingesting any PHI.
- SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months is required; we also need a brief summary of audit scope (does it cover hosting & infra, data handling, and change control?).
- Audit logs: we need an explanation of what logs are retained (access logs, admin actions) and retention windows — standard is 365 days.
- KMS/Encryption: do you support a customer-managed KMS in Dedicated or Private? For on-prem we will own the key material.

On deployment: our security team prefers Private VPC or on-prem but understands Dedicated may be acceptable if the contractual and technical controls meet our requirements.

Can you send the SOC2 report and BAA template and a proposed agenda for the technical deep-dive? Procurement is available to start contracting conversations next week.

Best,

Thanks Neha — quick notes and I've attached the files we normally share with prospects for security/ procurement: SOC2 Type II (redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf) and our standard BAA template (BAA_template_redwood.docx).

High-level answers to Elara's asks:
- SOC2 scope: covers hosting, infra, change management, and data handling for our hosted and dedicated control planes (see report appendix).
- Audit logs: we retain admin and access logs for 12 months by default; longer retention can be configured for Dedicated/Private at customer request.
- KMS: Dedicated and Private support customer-managed KMS (we integrate with customer AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault when in Dedicated; for Private VPC we support customer-managed HSM/KMS. Hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys unless a private instance is provisioned).
- On-prem: feasible but requires professional services and sizing exercise — needs SOW; estimate 8-12 weeks for initial deployment depending on site requirements.

Recommend: send the SOC2 (redacted) + BAA to procurement and schedule a 60-min technical call with Marissa (SE) + me for 3/9. I'll be prepared to discuss logs/KMS, network topology, and audit support.

Dylan Brooks
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
